intro: Mundhuke Velledhanu is the latest Christian Telugu song written & tuned by Shanti Abdias, sung by Ps. Kiran Abdias and music composed by Enoch Jagan. This song was released on November 15, 2025 through Kiran Abdias YouTube channel.
